===[[Savannah Region, Ghana|Savannah Region]]===
[[Image:Districts of the Savannah Region (2018).png|thumb|right|600px|Districts of the Savannah Region]]
The Savannah Region of Ghana was created by a referendum in December 2018. It was part of then [[Northern Region, Ghana|Northern Region]] of Ghana. It contains 7 districts, 1 municipal and 6 ordinary districts.
